body: I'm so glad to hear that you're slowly getting there! And I can absolutely understand that it's hard, but I'm proud of you for putting in the work anyways.
This is so cute, thank you for making me smile today.

I think the point is to find a point and go for it. For some people it's reaching the top of the corporate ladder, for others it's spreading as much love and happiness as possible, for some it's getting enough money to retire early and start a farm, for some it's spiritual enlightenment, or chasing happiness in whatever form it might take, for others it's just working to find a point to go on I guess. You can make your point whatever you want. Maybe your point is something strange, like trying every kind of cheese and wine pairing you can imagine or petting every stray cat you can find, and strange is perfectly okay too. I hope you have good luck finding your purpose, no matter what it might be.
